items.title: Jake Hanna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Upstate New York guy, wasn’t he? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, Syracuse.

ctx.x: No they just called it the “swinging herd,” that’s all. It had a nucleus, it was Bill Chase, Sal, myself and Nat and Chuck and that’s all we had. It was about four or five nucleus, if we could keep Sal all the time, it was hard to keep him in the band you know. But if he was there, he was the clean up hitter you know, he was the Babe Ruth. He was the attraction really. He was the attraction.
Upstate New York guy, wasn’t he?
